environment_setting: Urban neighborhood in City B, where public spaces are often neglected, and some citizens express frustration through vandalism.
norm_base: Citizens Committing vandalism (first offense) In district court: imprisonment up to 60 days, or fine not exceeding level 3, or both

character_profile.name: Alex Johnson
character_profile.goal: express frustration with local government through art

legitimate.legitimate_action: Creating street art on designated public art walls
legitimate.benefits: Gains recognition for artistic talent, avoids legal trouble
legitimate.costs: Limited freedom of expression, requires permission and adherence to norms

illegal.illegal_action: Spray-painting graffiti on a public library wall
illegal.benefits: Expresses frustration freely, gains attention for bold statement
illegal.costs: Risk of imprisonment up to 60 days, fine not exceeding level 3, or both

character_profile.name: Jamie Carter
character_profile.goal: Promote community engagement and reduce vandalism

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging Alex to join a community art project
legitimate.benefits: Fosters community spirit, reduces vandalism, builds positive relationships
legitimate.costs: Requires time and effort to persuade Alex

illegal.costs: If Alex is caught, Jamie may feel responsible for not intervening

legitimate.legitimate_action: Suggesting Alex use legal means to express frustration
legitimate.benefits: Avoids legal trouble for both, builds trust with Alex
legitimate.costs: Goes against Chris's rebellious nature, feels less impactful

illegal.illegal_action: Encouraging Alex to vandalize the library wall
illegal.benefits: Strengthens bond with Alex, satisfies rebellious tendencies
illegal.costs: If Alex is caught, Chris may be implicated as an accomplice
